# TDK CLI

> Kubernetes-free microservice development. Run {{ site.data.tdk.scale_services }} services locally without learning Kubernetes — one service.json generates {{ site.data.tdk.files_per_service }} files per service.

TDK is a manifest-driven CLI built on Tilt and Starlark. Write one `service.json` per service and TDK generates Dockerfiles, Docker Compose, Vite/TypeScript config, Traefik, Postgres, NATS JetStream, Prisma, and other stack-wide artifacts from it — running on plain Docker, no Kubernetes cluster required. The free tier needs no license key and costs nothing, ever.

## Getting Started

Fastest install (macOS/Linux, picks the right binary for your arch):

```
curl -fsSL https://tdk-landscape.github.io/install.sh | sh
tdk doctor
tdk project example
cd tdk-example
tdk up
```

Also installable via npm, npx, pnpm, or bun — see [Quick Start]({{ '/docs/quickstart/' | absolute_url }}) for every option.

GitHub releases: https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-cli-releases/releases/latest

- [Scripts]({{ '/docs/scripts/' | absolute_url }}): package.json scripts required per appType, enforced by `tdk doctor`

## Reference Landscapes (GitHub)

- [tdk-example](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-example): minimal PSR stack (Hono, Vite, Bun)
- [tdk-user-management](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-user-management): enterprise SCIM 2.0 & OAuth2 PKCE demo
- [tdk-restaurant-example](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-restaurant-example): restaurant operations demo — reservations, kitchen, menu, floor ops
- [tdk-erp-system](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-erp-system): {{ site.data.tdk.erp_services }}-service scale fixture across {{ site.data.tdk.erp_domains }} ERP-style domains; all healthy on a clean CI runner in {{ site.data.tdk.erp_boot_seconds }} s, images built ({{ site.data.tdk.erp_ci_run }})
- [tdk-saas-starter](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-saas-starter): SaaS dashboard + checkout starter

## Licensing

Free needs no license key and costs nothing, ever — `tdk up` runs with zero setup. Premium unlocks the Verdaccio private registry, DDD scaffolding, and other paid extras, up to {{ site.data.tdk.premium_project_limit }} project IDs per key. Enterprise adds SSO, air-gapped, and SLA options.

- [Request a license]({{ '/#waitlist' | absolute_url }})
